en-US.description: Upload a prototype silhouette and choose a design mode to generate new styles through inspiration transfer, bestseller extension, or themed series development.
en-US.designType.bestseller.desc: Extend bestsellers within the same category. Keep the pattern and fabric, change design details, and preview finished-garment results without hand sketches.
en-US.designType.inspiration.desc: Upload a prototype silhouette and an inspiration image to keep the silhouette while applying the inspiration design details.
en-US.designType.series.desc: Generate a themed series while preserving the core design language and varying silhouette, sleeve length, hem length, and structure for different styling scenes.
en-US.empty.garmentCategoryMore: Please select a garment category under More
en-US.empty.inspirationImage: Please upload an inspiration image first
en-US.empty.prototypeImage: Please upload a prototype image first
en-US.empty.seriesTheme: Please enter a series theme first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.label: Style Design
en-US.placeholder.designPointDescription: For example: double-zip placket, 3D patch pockets, notch lapel collar
en-US.placeholder.seriesTheme: For example: urban commute, retro collegiate, light outdoor
en-US.upload.inspirationImage.help: Upload one inspiration image. AI will borrow its color, craftsmanship, trims, and decorative language while keeping the prototype silhouette.
en-US.upload.prototypeImage.help: Upload one or more prototype images. Each prototype is paired with the inspiration image for a separate generation.

zh-CN.description: 上传原型廓形图并选择设计类型，通过灵感设计、爆款延伸或系列设计快速生成新款成衣方案。
zh-CN.designType.bestseller.desc: 基于爆款快速扩展同品类新款，在不改变版型/面料的情况下改变设计点，无需手绘即可预览成衣效果，复用版型、快速决策。
zh-CN.designType.inspiration.desc: 上传参考廓形的原型图与灵感图，一键生成保留原型廓形、并应用灵感图设计细节的新款。
zh-CN.designType.series.desc: 围绕主题生成系列新款，保持核心设计语言，通过调整廓形、袖长、长度等结构衍生适配不同穿搭场景的单品。
zh-CN.empty.garmentCategoryMore: 请在「更多」中选择具体服装品类
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 款式设计
zh-CN.placeholder.designPointDescription: 例如：门襟改双拉链、口袋改立体贴袋、领型改戗驳领
zh-CN.placeholder.seriesTheme: 请输入，例如：都市通勤、复古学院、轻户外
zh-CN.upload.inspirationImage.help: 上传 1 张灵感图，AI 将借鉴其配色、工艺、辅料与装饰语言，同时严格保持原型图的廓形。
zh-CN.upload.prototypeImage.help: 可上传多张原型图，每张原型图将分别与灵感图配对生成。
